fileheader.author: Geon-Hong Kim
fileheader.note:
This model represents the Goshawk 10s tailsitter VTOL aircraft.
Aircraft Specifications: - Type: Tailsitter VTOL quadplane - MTOW: 4 kg (8.82 lbs) - Payload: 1 kg (2.21 lbs) - Wing Span: 1.2 m (3.94 ft) - Wing Area: 0.2 m² (2.15 ft²) - Mean Chord: 0.1667 m (0.547 ft) - Aspect Ratio: 7.20 - Cruise Speed: 22 m/s (79.2 km/h) - Endurance: 30 min - Max Altitude: 500 m
Propulsion: - 4x T-Motor AT3520 550KV brushless motors - Max thrust per motor: 11.114 kg (109.1 N) - Total max thrust: 44.456 kg (436.4 N) - Max power per motor: 2685 W - Battery: 12S LiPo (46V nominal)
Motor Configuration (X-layout): - Motor 0: Front-Right (Counter-Clockwise) - Motor 1: Aft-Left (Counter-Clockwise) - Motor 2: Front-Left (Clockwise) - Motor 3: Aft-Right (Clockwise)
Motor Physical Layout: - Longitudinal spacing: 614.11 mm (24.18 in) - Lateral spacing: 1545.48 mm (60.85 in)
Control: - No traditional control surfaces - Attitude control via differential thrust only - Direct motor control via ArduPilot SITL interface
Coordinate System: - Aircraft oriented as tailsitter (fuselage vertical in hover) - Body frame: X-forward, Y-right wing, Z-down - Hover orientation: pitch -90 degrees from level flight
